Hero Ice Wizard, release 2026-09-05 (Season 87). Ability Frosty Fella, 2 elixir, single use: triggers on the next slowing hit and spawns a Snowman 1 tile behind the target (works on towers). Snowman: 266 HP at level 11 draining over a 7s lifetime, spawn damage 89 in a 2.5 tile radius (38 to crown towers), freezes everything inside that radius for as long as it lives (duration 7.0 is the cap), self-destructs 2s after all frozen targets die. Not published: Snowman collision radius and mass; other levels derived. https://royaleapi.com/blog/hero-ice-wizard-september-2026

The Hunter's 10 pellets are individual non-homing projectiles fanned out from him (wiki Hunter: they travel in random directions with a wide spread, more damage the closer he is, each bullet an individual hit that can break a shield; game data HunterProjectile projectileRange 6500, RoyaleAPI cr-api-data projectile_radius 300, scatter Line, homing false, check_collisions true, multiple_projectiles 10). No published spread angle: the 2019 community frame analysis found one pellet aimed at the target and the others 5 degrees apart, 4 on one side and 5 on the other (the asymmetry thread), which puts all 10 on a body within a tile, 5 on a troop at his 4 tile range and 7 on a Princess Tower from there, matching the wiki's placement advice. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Hunter https://cache.statsroyale.com/gamedata-v5.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RoyaleAPI/cr-api-data/master/docs/json/cards_stats.json https://www.reddit.com/r/ClashRoyale/comments/bj3kzk/hunter_assymetry_three_bullets_go_to_the_left/

The Fisherman's hook, absent from every stat source the build reads (ClashStrategic lists his melee only): game data Fisherman specialMinRange 3500, specialRange 7000, specialLoadTime 1300, projectileSpecialData FishermanProjectile speed 800; RoyaleAPI cr-api-data characters Fisherman damage_special 0 and special_ignore_buildings false, projectiles FishermanProjectile homing, drag_back_speed 850, drag_self_speed 450, target_buff IceWizardSlowDown (hit_speed_multiplier and speed_multiplier -35) buff_time 2500. Speeds in tiles per second (game speed / 50 like projectile.speed). Wiki Fisherman: if there are ground units between 3.5 and 7 tiles of him, he will stop moving and begin charging a hook attack which takes 1.3 seconds to execute, and either pulls enemy troops towards him, or pulls himself towards buildings, and slows their movement and attack speed by 35 percent (the wiki says 1.5 s, the game data 2.5). https://cache.statsroyale.com/gamedata-v5.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RoyaleAPI/cr-api-data/master/docs/json/cards_stats.json https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Fisherman
